rav-chiyya-bar-avin.name: Rav Ḥiyya bar Avin
rav-chiyya-bar-avin.bio: Babylonian Amora who often transmits the teachings of earlier sages.
rav-chiyya-bar-avin.prompt: A Babylonian scholar in his 50s with a dark beard touched with grey and an attentive, careful look, as if repeating a teaching word for word; background of mudbrick academy walls and oil lamps.

rabbi-chiyya.name: Rabbi Ḥiyya
rabbi-chiyya.era: Tanna/Amora · Babylonia and the Land of Israel, late 2nd–early 3rd century
rabbi-chiyya.bio: Rabbi Ḥiyya the Great, a Babylonian-born student and colleague of Rabbi Yehuda HaNasi who settled in the Land of Israel and taught collections of baraitot.
rabbi-chiyya.prompt: A venerable Babylonian-born scholar in his 60s with a full silver beard and a warm, steady gaze, holding a bundle of scrolls of the teachings he collected; background of limestone arches and olive trees in the Land of Israel.
